sahneler.metin: Before dawn, a regional jet ran off the end of a runway in Kentucky.
It crashed into trees, and forty nine people were killed.
It had lined up on the wrong runway.
That runway was short and unlit.
Construction had changed the usual taxi route.
Neither pilot noticed the heading didn't match.
The jet couldn't lift off in time.

aciklama:
Comair 5191 crashed after taking off from a runway far too short. The cause: take-off from a short, unlit general-aviation runway instead of the assigned runway.
